description: This file defines the DefaultMediaFileStoreCacheFileProvider class, which manages caching of media files in a web application, including setting, deleting, and purging cache files and directories.

classes.name: DefaultMediaFileStoreCacheFileProvider
classes.description: A class that provides caching functionality for media files, including setting cache, checking cache existence, and deleting cache files or directories.

methods.name: IsCachedAsync
methods.description: Checks asynchronously if a given file path is cached.

methods.name: SetCacheAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously saves a stream to the cache, handling partial downloads and errors.

methods.name: PurgeAsync
methods.description: Deletes all cache files and folders, returning whether errors occurred.

methods.name: TryDeleteDirectoryAsync
methods.description: Attempts to delete a cache directory asynchronously.

methods.name: TryDeleteFileAsync
methods.description: Attempts to delete a cache file asynchronously.
